name: Hearts
description: Hearts is a classic trick-taking card game belonging to the 'evasion' family. Unlike most trick-taking games, the goal is to avoid winning tricks that contain penalty cards. Each heart is 1 penalty point, and the Queen of Spades is 13. The ultimate objective is to have the lowest score, or to 'Shoot the Moon' by taking all penalty cards.

history.origins: Hearts appeared in the USA in the 1880s, based on earlier evasion games from Europe such as Reversis and Polignac.
timeline: 1880s: Hearts first documented in American game books.
1909: The Queen of Spades ('Black Lady') standardly included as a 13-point penalty card.
1990s: Becomes a global phenomenon after being included in Microsoft Windows 3.1.
Present: One of the most played card games online and in Windows.
history.cultural: Known worldwide due to its inclusion in early Windows operating systems. One of the most recognizable card games globally.
history.evolution: Originally a simple game of avoiding hearts, it evolved to include the high penalty of the Queen of Spades and the 'Shoot the Moon' reversal rule.

setup.players: 4 players playing individually. For 3 players remove the 2 of Diamonds. For 5 players remove two low cards.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card deck. Ranking: Ace (high) down to 2 (low) in each suit.
setup.dealing: Deal all 13 cards to each player (one at a time, face-down). After looking at their hands, players pass 3 cards to an opponent. Passing direction rotates each round: Left, Right, Across, then No Pass (a 'hold' round). This 4-round cycle repeats.

rules.objective: Have the lowest cumulative score when any player reaches 100 points. Avoid taking tricks containing hearts (1 point each) and the Queen of Spades (13 points).
rules.gameplay:
1. PASSING: After the deal, each player selects 3 cards to pass to an opponent (direction rotates: Left, Right, Across, None). All passes are simultaneous.
2. OPENING LEAD: The player with the 2 of Clubs leads it to the first trick.
3. FOLLOWING SUIT: Players must follow the suit led if possible. If unable to follow suit, any card may be played (except penalty cards on the first trick).
4. WINNING TRICKS: The highest card of the suit led wins the trick. There is no trump suit. The trick winner leads the next trick.
5. BREAKING HEARTS: Hearts cannot be led until a heart has been played ('discarded') on a previous trick, or the player has nothing but hearts remaining.
6. FIRST TRICK RESTRICTION: No penalty cards (hearts or Queen of Spades) may be played on the first trick.
7. SCORING: After all 13 tricks are played, each player counts penalty points in their captured tricks. Each heart = 1 point, Queen of Spades = 13 points. Maximum penalty per round = 26 points.
8. SHOOT THE MOON: If one player captures ALL 13 hearts AND the Queen of Spades, they score 0 and every other player scores 26 points.
9. GAME END: Play continues across rounds until a player reaches 100 cumulative points. The player with the lowest score at that point wins.
keyRules: Must follow suit if possible; if void in the led suit, may play any card (with first-trick restrictions).
Hearts cannot be led until 'broken' (a heart has been played on a previous trick).
No penalty cards (hearts or Queen of Spades) on the first trick.
Queen of Spades = 13 penalty points; each heart = 1 penalty point.
Shoot the Moon: Taking all 26 penalty points gives 0 to shooter, 26 to everyone else.
Passing direction rotates: Left → Right → Across → None (hold), then repeats.
2 of Clubs always leads the first trick of each round.

strategy.basic: Void suits early so you can discard hearts or the Queen of Spades when others lead that suit. Pass high cards you don't want.
strategy.intermediate: Protect your high Spades. If you have the Ace or King of Spades, pass them or keep enough low Spades to duck under the Queen. Track which hearts and the Queen have been played.
strategy.advanced: Shooting the Moon requires high cards across multiple suits to maintain lead and capture all point cards. If you see an opponent is collecting all penalty cards, sacrifice a trick to take one heart to block them. Count cards meticulously to know when it's safe to lead high.
tips: Passing high cards is common, but sometimes keeping them is safer if you have many low cards in the same suit.
Track which Spades have been played to know if the Queen is still out.
The player who leads controls the game — try to maintain lead when you have safe suits.
In a 'no pass' round, play more conservatively since you're stuck with your hand.

variations.name: Omnibus Hearts
variations.description: The Jack of Diamonds is worth -10 points (bonus). Adds an incentive to take certain tricks.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant scoring change (Jack of Diamonds -10) not yet mapped to engine constants; add when implementing.

variations.name: Spot Hearts
variations.description: Each heart card is worth its face value in penalty points (Ace=14, King=13, etc.) instead of 1 point each.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant card values differ from base game; map to engine overrides when implementing.

variations.name: Cancellation Hearts
variations.description: For 6-8 players using two decks. When two identical cards appear in the same trick, they cancel each other out. Cancelled cards cannot win the trick.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant uses two decks and cancellation rules; add deckCount and trick logic overrides when implementing.

scoring.description: Penalty-based scoring. Each heart captured = 1 point. Queen of Spades = 13 points. Maximum penalty per round = 26 points. Shoot the Moon reversal: if one player takes all 26, they get 0 and others get 26.
scoring.winCondition: Game ends when any player reaches 100 cumulative points. The player with the lowest cumulative score at that point wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: A 4-player evasion trick-taking game where the goal is to avoid winning tricks with penalty cards (hearts and the Queen of Spades), with the dramatic option to 'Shoot the Moon' by capturing all penalty cards.

hero.title: HEARTS
hero.subtitle: Avoid the Penalties
hero.tagline: Pass wisely. Void suits early. Shoot the moon or stay low.
